policy: Strict QC 1 for position, time, selected pressure and each selected variable. A/D selects adjusted arrays; R selects raw. No fallback from bad/missing adjusted to raw. Original raw/adjusted values and QC retained. Depth=-gsw.z_from_p(pressure, latitude); no dynamic-height correction. Potential temperature uses TEOS-10 GSW pt0_from_t after SA_from_SP; not direct TEMP vs thetao.
